d: Provide legal advice on land development, master planning, subdivision, titling, and related regulatory approvals.
Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize real estate agreements, including sale, lease, development, off-plan sales, and leasing documentation.
Liaise with REGA and other relevant regulatory authorities, including matters involving the Ejar platform and Wafi program.

Draft and negotiate documentation for hotel and branded residence developments, including letters of intent, term sheets, technical services agreements, brand licensing agreements, and hotel management arrangements.
Provide legal support for facilities management, property management, estate management, and asset management arrangements.

8+ years of relevant legal experience, depending on the seniority/grade of the position.
Strong experience in real estate, land development, property transactions, and commercial contracting.
Experience drafting and negotiating sale, lease, development, property management, and related real estate agreements.
Knowledge of the Saudi Arabian real estate regulatory environment, with exposure to REGA, Ejar, and Wafi highly desirable.
Experience supporting hospitality, hotel management, or branded residence developments is advantageous.
Strong contract drafting, negotiation, stakeholder management, and legal advisory skills.
